newsitem.title: USA: Hyperion to become MCI preferred provider.
newsitem.headline: Hyperion to become MCI preferred provider.

text.p: Hyperion Telecommunications Inc on Monday said it entered into an non-binding letter of intent with MCI Communications Corp's MCImetro Access Transmission Services Inc that would name it MCI's preferred provider for new and end user dedicated access circuits.
In return, MCI would be issued warrants to purchase 2.5 percent of Hyperion's Class A common stock.

MCI could be issued warrants to purchase up to an additional six percent of the stock at fair market value at time of issuance if MCI meets agreed upon purchase volume revenue thresholds, Hyperion said.

The final agreement would also make Hyperion the preferred provider for conversion of existing and user dedicated access circuits from incumbent local exchange carriers. Further, Hyperion would have the right to first refusal to provide MCI all new dedicated local network access circuits.
MCI would have the option to purchase local loop transport services from Hyperion where Hyperion is collocated with an incumbent local exchange carrier, Hyperion said.
The arrangements would apply for a five-year term with MCI having a five-year renewal option, Hyperion said.

Dan Milliard, president and chief operating officer at Hyperion, said the agreement "further solidifies (Hyperion's) strategic relationship with MCI in markets we serve. The agreement provides an excellent source of network traffic for our base dedicated access business and further stimulates network revenue growth for those markets."
Milliard added the agreement provides a framework for Hyperion to negotiate an MCI branded wholesale local switched services product that would complement the MCI long distance networks.
